history.content: Hi, my phone has no signal at all. I can't send picture messages or use mobile data. Can you help?

I can help you with that! To begin troubleshooting, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can assist you further.
My phone number is +1-617-555-0148 and my name is Sofia Martinez.

Thank you for the information. Your line is currently active, so let's start troubleshooting your signal and connectivity issues.

To proceed, I’ll need your help to check a few things on your phone. Are you able to see any icons in your phone’s status bar, such as Airplane Mode, signal bars, or network type (like 4G/5G)? If not, I can guide you through checking these details step by step. Would you like to continue with the guided troubleshooting?
I don't see any signal bars or network type icons at the top of my phone. I don't see Airplane Mode either. Yes, please guide me through the troubleshooting.

Thank you for confirming. Let’s start by checking your phone’s status bar details to see if there are any indicators of what might be wrong.

Please use the “check_status_bar” function on your phone and let me know what it shows. This will help us determine if Airplane Mode is on, if there’s no signal, or if there are any other relevant icons displayed.
I just checked, and my status bar shows Airplane Mode is on, No Signal, and Data Disabled.

It looks like Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone, which disables all wireless connections, including cellular service and mobile data. This is why you have no signal and cannot use mobile data or send picture messages.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. Once you’ve done that, check if the signal bars and network type icons appear at the top of your screen. Let me know what you see after turning off Airplane Mode, and we’ll continue troubleshooting if needed.
Airplane mode is now off. I see one bar of signal, but there’s still no 4G or 5G icon, and the data icon is missing.

Thank you for the update. Now that Airplane Mode is off and you have one bar of signal, let’s check why mobile data isn’t working and why you don’t see a 4G/5G icon.

Please do the following steps on your phone:

1. Check if mobile data is enabled. If it’s off, please turn it on.
2. If mobile data is already on, let me know if you see any change in the signal or data icons at the top of your screen.

After you’ve checked or enabled mobile data, let me know what you see. If there’s still no data connection, we’ll continue with the next troubleshooting steps.
Mobile data is now ON. I now see two bars of signal, but there’s still no 4G or 5G icon and no data icon at the top of the screen.

Thank you for enabling mobile data. Since you still don’t see a 4G/5G icon or a data icon, let’s check your phone’s network mode settings. Sometimes, if your phone is set to use only older networks (like 2G or 3G), you won’t see 4G/5G icons or get fast data.

Please check your phone’s network mode preference and let me know what it is currently set to (for example: 2G only, 3G only, 4G/5G preferred, etc.). If you’re not sure how to check, I can guide you through the process.
Actually, my phone is set to 4G/5G preferred. What should I try next?

Thank you for confirming your network mode is set to 4G/5G preferred. Since you still don’t see a data icon or network type, the next step is to check your phone’s APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can prevent your phone from connecting to mobile data networks.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if anything looks incorrect or if the APN/MMSC fields are empty. If you’re unsure, I can guide you through resetting your APN settings to default, which often resolves this issue. Would you like instructions to reset your APN settings?
I reset the APN settings to default and saw a message saying to reboot the device for the changes to take effect. Should I go ahead and restart my phone now?

Yes, please go ahead and restart your phone now. Rebooting will apply the new APN settings.

After your phone restarts, check if you see the 4G/5G icon or a data icon at the top of your screen, and let me know if your signal and mobile data are working. If you still have issues, we’ll continue troubleshooting.
I restarted my phone. Now I see three bars of signal and the 5G icon at the top of my screen. Should I try sending a picture message to check if everything is working?

Yes, please try sending a picture message (MMS) to check if everything is working correctly. Also, try browsing the internet or using an app that requires mobile data to confirm your data connection is active.

Let me know if you’re able to send the picture message and use mobile data successfully, or if you encounter any issues.
I was able to send a picture message successfully and browsing the internet works fine. Everything seems to be working now—signal is excellent, 5G is showing, and the speed is great.

That’s great to hear! Your phone’s signal, mobile data, and MMS are all working properly now.

If you have any other questions or need further assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a wonderful day!
